evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 紫碧山房
evidence.excerpt_zh: 鴻慈永祜後垣西北為紫碧山房前宇為横雲堂山房東巖洞中為石帆室東南為豐樂軒北為霽華樓迤東為景暉樓横雲堂西池上為澄素樓西北為引溪亭（圎圓明園册）臣等謹按紫碧山房額有二其一恭懸正宇内一懸穿堂門檐與引溪亭額皆世宗御書紫碧山房正宇檐額曰樂在人和及横雲堂諸額皆皇上御書
evidence.summary: North-west beyond the rear wall of 鴻慈永祜: 紫碧山房 with 横雲堂, the cave room 石帆室, 豐樂軒, 霽華樓, 景暉樓, 澄素樓 on the pond and 引溪亭.

evidence.title: 丰乐轩 in 紫碧山房
evidence.excerpt_zh: 鴻慈永祜後垣西北為紫碧山房前宇為横雲堂山房東巖洞中為石帆室東南為豐樂軒北為霽華樓
evidence.summary: S05 puts 丰乐轩 south-east of 石帆室 in 紫碧山房.: S01 labels it in YM22.

evidence.title: 石帆室: 乾隆二十六年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆二十六年 (1761), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 峰如倒插室如浮，便拟称帆恰当不。忆似田盘精舍里，石林云海泛虚舟。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 石帆室, 1761, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 石帆室: 乾隆二十六年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆二十六年 (1761), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 宁湏五两始飘扬，容裔摩空几幅张。讵必赋吴将志越，已看引汉更牵湘。惊涛骇浪曾何有，抹月批风是所常。无恙迥悬云海阔，祗疑牛渚泛仙航。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 石帆室, 1761, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 石帆室
evidence.locator: v3 p.120, under 紫碧山房; source ref 8-386
evidence.excerpt_zh: 宁须五两始飘扬，容裔摩空几幅张。讵必赋吴将志越，已看引汉更牵湘。惊涛骇浪曾何有，抹月批风是所常。无恙回悬云海阔，只疑牛渚泛仙航。
evidence.summary: Poem 石帆室 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1761, filed by the editors under 紫碧山房.

evidence.title: 石帆室
evidence.locator: v3 p.125, under 紫碧山房; source ref 9-151
evidence.excerpt_zh: 万石磊嵚㟢，小斋倚石为。飞来若无定，浮去竟何之。讵藉风添力，端因雪有姿。如询停舣处，只在白云涯。
evidence.summary: Poem 石帆室 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1766, filed by the editors under 紫碧山房.

evidence.title: 石帆室: 嘉庆二年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆二年 (1797), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 石舫翼然碧溪浒，筑成船室具帆橹。凭窗延览镜清澄，未许鸣桡过前浦。光含天水图画披，浴鹭浮鸥自转移。盘石根基任诚重，济川作楫还系思。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 石帆室, 1797, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 石帆室
evidence.locator: from p.198, under 紫碧山房
evidence.summary: 石帆室: 6 dated items, 1761-1797, of which 6 poems (Qianlong, Jiaqing); recurring themes: the view. First dated 1761, last dated 1797.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 紫碧山房
evidence.summary: Enlarged about 1760: inner gate, 含余清, the octagonal 翼翠亭, 丰乐轩, 纳翠轩, the boat-shaped 石帆室, the three-storey 景晖楼, 横云堂, a five-bay main hall 乐在人和, 澄素楼, 霁华楼. After 1860 the inner gate, main hall and 顺木天 pavilion survived under guard and were lost around 1900, say the editors.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
